question: Where was the 2025 World Para Athletics Grand Prix held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 World Para Athletics Grand Prix** is scheduled to be held in **New Delhi**, **India**.
 
• The event is a major part of the international calendar for para-athletics, bringing together elite athletes from across the globe to compete in various track and field disciplines.
 
• The **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** in **New Delhi** serves as the primary venue for this prestigious competition, offering world-class facilities for para-athletes.
 
• The tournament is organized under the aegis of **World Para Athletics**, the international governing body for the sport, in collaboration with the **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)**.
 
• Hosting the Grand Prix in **India** highlights the country's rising stature in the **Paralympic movement** and its commitment to promoting sports for persons with disabilities.
 
• Athletes participating in this Grand Prix aim to achieve **Minimum Entry Standards (MES)** and improve their **World Rankings** for upcoming major championships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Para Athletics Grand Prix Series:** 
 
 
• This is a series of international events launched by **World Para Athletics** to provide a high-level competition circuit for athletes with physical, intellectual, or vision impairments.
 
• The series includes multiple stops worldwide, including cities like **Dubai**, **Tunis**, and **Jesolo**, before concluding with the final rankings.
 
 
 
• **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI):**
 
 
• Founded in **1992**, the **PCI** is the national body responsible for the development and promotion of para-sports in **India**.
 
• It is recognized by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)** and the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, **Government of India**.
 
• The committee has been instrumental in **India**'s record-breaking performance at the **Paris 2024 Paralympics**, where the country secured **29 medals**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of New Delhi as a Sports Hub:**
 
 
• **New Delhi** has a long history of hosting mega-sporting events, including the **1951** and **1982 Asian Games** and the **2010 Commonwealth Games**.
 
• The **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** has a seating capacity of approximately **60,000** and features a synthetic track suitable for international athletics.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Indian Para-Athletics:**
 
 
• By hosting international meets like the **Grand Prix**, local athletes get the opportunity to compete against the best in the world on home soil, reducing travel burdens and increasing exposure.
 
• Such events also help in scouting new talent and sensitizing the general public towards **Para-sports** and inclusivity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Classification System:** In **World Para Athletics**, athletes are grouped into classes (denoted by 'T' for track and 'F' for field followed by a **number**) based on the impact of their impairment on performance to ensure fair competition.
 
• **Qualification Standards:** The results from the **2025 Grand Prix** in **New Delhi** are official and are used to determine eligibility for the **World Para Athletics Championships**.
 
• **Growth in Participation:** Over the last decade, the number of participating nations and athletes in the **Grand Prix** circuit has seen a steady increase, reflecting the global growth of **Para-sports**.
